_about: The ONNX Runtime the app is built and tested against (#383): one pin, read by scripts/fetch-ml-runtime.sh, scripts/installer-ml-runtime.py and CI, and shape-checked by crates/ml-pipeline/tests/runtime_manifest.rs. `member` is the library's path inside the archive; `install_as` is the name runtime::ensure looks for; `library_sha256` is that file's own digest once unpacked, which the fetch script and the per-installer check compare against. `notices` are copied from the archive's top directory (the first part of `member`) next to the library. `vc_runtime` lists the Visual C++ runtime DLLs the Windows library imports, which the installers put beside it, and the oldest version of them it runs on. A new version needs its own `min_macos`, digests, and a minor no lower than the `api-NN` feature on `ort`.
